title: IntelliJ & Copilot
summary: A supervised entry point for repository investigation and implementation.

sections.label: Useful work
sections.text: Inspect affected modules, edit a bounded change, run local checks, and prepare review evidence in the actual checkout.

sections.label: Current distinction
sections.text: JetBrains’ September update includes session-model selection for built-in subagents. Independent per-agent routing still depends on the harness. Do not transplant SDK configuration assumptions into every IDE mode.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Record the effective client, plugin, harness, model, and permitted tools. Verify execution evidence against the resulting revision.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended workflow steps: Investigate the cause, Development, Tests and review. These links are recommendations based on the guide content, not required product or process choices.
An environment record names the effective IDE, extension, harness and reported model where applicable. Unobserved routing remains unknown.
The scoped change is linked to the inspected checkout revision and the relevant neighboring implementation.
The evidence packet records actual local check output, permitted tools and unresolved environment issues against the resulting revision.
Existing source claims were not re-audited in this mapping pass. Project configuration, usefulness and actual check outcomes remain unverified.

catalog.applicability: Use this IntelliJ example when repository investigation and bounded changes happen in a supervised IDE checkout with Copilot. Record the effective client, plugin, harness, model and permitted tools, since independent per agent routing in the IDE still depends on the harness.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
